definitions.explanation: Extremely heavy rainfall; rain falling in torrents.

examples.japanese: {土砂降|どしゃぶ}りの{雨|あめ}だ。
{土砂降|どしゃぶ}りで{傘|かさ}が{役|やく}に{立|た}たなかった。
examples.english: My umbrella was useless in the downpour.

examples.japanese: {突然|とつぜん}{土砂降|どしゃぶ}りになってびしょ{濡|ぬ}れになった。
examples.english: It suddenly started pouring and I got soaking wet.

notes:
USAGE:
・{土砂降|どしゃぶ}りの{雨|あめ} - pouring rain
・{土砂降|どしゃぶ}りになる - to start pouring

INTENSITY SCALE (rain):
{小雨|こさめ} (drizzle) → {雨|あめ} (rain) → {大雨|おおあめ} (heavy rain) → {土砂降|どしゃぶ}り (downpour) → {豪雨|ごうう} (torrential rain)

ETYMOLOGY:
{土砂|どしゃ} (earth and sand) + {降|ふ}り (falling) - evoking the image of rain so heavy it seems like earth and sand are falling from the sky.
